answer: The oasis lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the timber is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, revoked by a single upheld challenge. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the relic is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
